metadata.description: Comprehensive inventory of all tools, capabilities, APIs, data sources, and systems in the repository

software_tools.name: validate-storage
software_tools.description: Comprehensive validation tool for the storage system. Checks schema validation, referential integrity, file existence, orphan detection, ID format, date format, required fields, duplicates, version validation, and length limits.

software_tools.name: test-edge-cases
software_tools.description: Edge case and boundary testing suite (35 tests) for the storage system.

software_tools.name: repair-storage
software_tools.description: Automated repair tool for common storage system issues. Supports --dry-run mode.

software_tools.name: grade-research
software_tools.description: Evaluates research JSON quality across five dimensions: citation count/quality, coverage breadth, depth, and specificity.

software_tools.name: merge-research
software_tools.description: Merges multiple team research JSON files by topic category with deduplication.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-websearch
software_tools.description: Multi-query web search via DuckDuckGo. Generates 3-5 query variants and deduplicates results.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-wikipedia
software_tools.description: Wikipedia API deep extraction with DuckDuckGo fallback.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-arxiv
software_tools.description: arXiv academic paper search with DuckDuckGo fallback.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-hybrid
software_tools.description: Hybrid multi-source aggregation combining web search, Wikipedia, and arXiv.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-iterative
software_tools.description: Iterative deepening search doing 3 rounds of progressively deeper DuckDuckGo queries.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-benchmark
software_tools.description: Benchmark harness that runs all data gathering methods and calculates quality scores.

software_tools.name: kb-validator
software_tools.description: Validates knowledge base entries and index.json consistency.

software_tools.name: index-rebuilder
software_tools.description: Auto-generates index.json files by scanning KB entries and team sessions. Supports --dry-run and --fix.

software_tools.name: cross-ref-checker
software_tools.description: Validates all cross-references across the repository. Detects cycles, orphans, and dangling entries.

software_tools.name: fast-search
software_tools.description: High-speed full-text search index compiled in Go. Query time <5ms. Supports exact match, multi-word AND, and phrase search.

software_tools.name: fast-validate
software_tools.description: High-speed repository structure validator compiled in Go. Completes in <2ms.

software_tools.name: fast-cache
software_tools.description: High-speed file-based key-value cache for API responses. SHA-256 keys, TTL support, sub-millisecond cache hits.

software_tools.name: kb-search
software_tools.description: Full-text search across KB entries, team logs, and script metadata using TF-IDF ranking.

software_tools.name: handoff-tracker
software_tools.description: Parses Handoff Notes from team session logs and tracks action item resolution.

software_tools.name: staleness-detector
software_tools.description: Repository health checker with 6 checks: stale statuses, regressions, unaddressed handoffs, broken references, index mismatches, orphan files.

software_tools.name: ddg-utils
software_tools.description: Shared DuckDuckGo search utilities with rate limiting (0.5s between requests).

software_tools.name: request-cache
software_tools.description: File-based HTTP response cache with SHA-256 keys, base64 storage, configurable TTL.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-openalex
software_tools.description: OpenAlex academic search via REST API. Searches 250M+ scholarly works.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-hackernews
software_tools.description: Hacker News search via Algolia API plus Firebase top stories.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-guardian
software_tools.description: Guardian news search via Open Platform API with DuckDuckGo fallback.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-semantic-scholar
software_tools.description: Semantic Scholar paper search via Academic Graph API.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-wikidata
software_tools.description: Wikidata knowledge graph search. Two-phase: search entities then fetch full details.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-github
software_tools.description: GitHub repository and code search via REST API.

software_tools.name: dedup-utils
software_tools.description: TF-IDF-based similarity scoring, deduplication, and source merging utilities.

software_tools.name: build-cross-ref-index
software_tools.description: Builds a master cross-reference index at storage/cross-references.json.

software_tools.name: search-storage
software_tools.description: Unified Search and Discovery Tool for the storage system.

software_tools.name: viz-data-flow
software_tools.description: D3.js v7 left-to-right flow diagram showing script-to-source data connections.

software_tools.name: viz-kb-graph
software_tools.description: D3.js v7 top-down layered DAG of Knowledge Base entry dependencies.

software_tools.name: viz-team-hierarchy
software_tools.description: D3.js v7 force-directed graph showing team hierarchy, agent membership, and knowledge dependencies.

software_tools.name: stress-test-writes
software_tools.description: Stress test for storage system write operations.

software_tools.name: stress-test-reads (id)
software_tools.description: Stress test for storage system reads by ID.

software_tools.name: stress-test-reads (category)
software_tools.description: Stress test for storage system reads by category.

software_tools.name: stress-test-reads (cross-ref)
software_tools.description: Stress test for storage system cross-reference reads.

software_tools.name: stress-test-setup-reads
software_tools.description: Setup script for storage stress test read operations.

software_tools.name: test-cross-references
software_tools.description: Test suite for cross-reference functionality.

software_tools.name: data-gathering-methods-benchmark
software_tools.description: Benchmark runner within methods directory (distinct from SCR-0011).

api_integrations.name: Sonnet Research API
api_integrations.description: Multi-agent research system using Claude Sonnet. Supports variable sub-agents, request queuing, priority scheduling, result sorting, and automated import into repo storage.

data_sources.note: The following sources have detailed spec files in storage/sources/ but are NOT in the sources index.json

communication_systems.name: Proto A - JSONL Message Bus + SQLite Shared State
communication_systems.description: Primary inter-agent communication system. JSONL append-only message bus with SQLite WAL shared state.

modules.name: bus.py
modules.description: JSONL append-only message bus with POSIX atomic writes

modules.name: state.py
modules.description: SQLite WAL shared state (agent registry, rate limiting, phase signals, findings)

modules.name: coordinator.py
modules.description: Coordinator that bridges bus and state layers

communication_systems.name: Proto B - Alternative Communication System
communication_systems.description: Alternative communication system using mmap and FIFOs. Archived after comparative testing showed Proto A was superior.

coordination_infrastructure.name: Coordinator Hub
coordination_infrastructure.description: Real-time agent monitoring via shared SQLite status table. Hub-and-spoke model with AgentReporter and CoordinatorDashboard.

coordination_infrastructure.name: Dashboard
coordination_infrastructure.description: Text-based dashboard for Proto A coordination system. Displays agents, status, messages, and system health.

coordination_infrastructure.name: Help Protocol
coordination_infrastructure.description: Team help requests, idle detection, and automatic work assignment. Solves the problem of teams finishing early and sitting idle.

coordination_infrastructure.name: Direct Channels
coordination_infrastructure.description: Direct team-to-team channels, presence tracking, and work progress broadcasting. Supports named, topic, team, and broadcast channels.

coordination_infrastructure.name: Work Stealing
coordination_infrastructure.description: Work Stealing, Pipeline Chaining, and Shared Scratchpad for Proto A. Three coordination primitives on top of SQLite WAL.

coordination_infrastructure.name: Multi-Team Runner
coordination_infrastructure.description: Production-ready multi-team runner for Proto A. Launches N teams with M agents each, communicating via bus and SQLite.

coordination_infrastructure.name: Think Tank Convergence
coordination_infrastructure.description: Reads team findings from SQLite and output JSON files, cross-references and deduplicates them.

coordination_infrastructure.name: Bus CLI
coordination_infrastructure.description: CLI tool for agents to read/write the Proto A JSONL message bus. Commands: write, read_msgs, list_channels.

coordination_infrastructure.name: Hub Monitor Database
coordination_infrastructure.description: SQLite database used by the Coordinator Hub for agent status tracking.

coordination_infrastructure.name: Bug Reports
coordination_infrastructure.description: Structured bug reports: bug-report-core.json, bug-report-infra.json, bug-report-proto.json

coordination_infrastructure.name: Team Directories
coordination_infrastructure.description: 18 team output directories for coordination data: alpha-1, alpha-2, beta-1, beta-2, gamma, research, research-bugs, research-stress, think-tank-bugs, think-tank-bugs-1/2/3, think-tank-hub, think-tank-proposals, think-tank-report.json, think-tank-stress, think-tank-v2, think-tank-v3
